translations.Recommended character/body swap defaults:
Recommended character/body swap defaults:
- Keep generated/retargeted material sidecar enabled.
- Leave direct source material sidecar replacement off.
- Leave full source .app_xml replacement off.
- Use Character Swap Plan when swapping character body/head assets.

Recommended weapon/item swap defaults:
- Use Select Item Family when the source has its own material sidecar and textures.
- Use Select Physics only when the source and target physics contract is intentionally being replaced.
- Use direct source model payload when preserving donor physics/material wrappers matters more than alignment transforms.
- Keep prefab/socket rows manual unless you intentionally want to change held/sheath placement metadata.

Generated/retargeted material sidecar means the later alignment step patches the target .pac_xml/.pami from the reviewed mapping and texture plan. This is usually safer than copying the source .pac_xml because source and target submesh wrappers can differ. It is not safe when the source carries its own cloth/PBD contract, because regenerating the target sidecar drops those bindings.

Replace target material sidecar copies selected source sidecar bytes onto the target sidecar path. This is the option that carries a donor's cloth/PBD and physics references across.

Replace target appearance descriptor copies the full source .app_xml. This can redirect hair, armor, customization, scale, sockets, prefab data, and other character graph links.

Character Swap Plan creates a surgical target .app_xml patch for body/head references while preserving target hair, armor, skeleton, and physics by default.

Checked table rows are written as loose replacement payloads. Rows marked as detected references are shown for context and manual selection; they are not automatically required just because they were found.

Select Graph Textures selects only safe DDS texture rows from the character graph. Sidecars, skeleton, physics, and full appearance descriptors remain explicit manual choices.
translations.Recommended default. Uses placement/rebu: Recommended default. Uses placement/rebuild so offsets, transforms, and removed parts still apply, then enables complete source-owned material routing and includes source DDS plus HKX/HKT physics rows.
translations.Recommended first run: put the portable: Recommended first run: put the portable EXE in its own folder, set the game/package path under Archive Locations, click Init Workspace, then use the bundled DirectXTex/native DDS tools. External-tool download buttons open official pages in your browser instead of downloading files inside the app.
translations.Recommended first test. Upscale visible: Recommended first test. Upscale visible color/UI-style maps only; leave normals, masks, grayscale technical maps, vectors, and unknown maps unchanged.
